text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I'm visiting the amusement
park
everyone's been raving about with
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Did you know that they only just
refurbished this
roller coaster? It's
getting a lot of buzz.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But in my opinion, the crown jewel is the
parade!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You're right about that! It should be a
great
reference for my work...
choice_data_list: イベント企画に活かせそうですね

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to see the parade!
...For
reference!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I've already researched the
optimal
viewing spot, so let's make our
way there right
away!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's about to start. Deep breaths.
Stay
composed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello looks a little antsy. Just as
I'm about
to say something to her, I'm
cut off by...

text_block_list.name: Carrot Queen
text_block_list.text:
Orange you glad to see me? ☆ It's time
to dance
with the Carrot Queen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wooow!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful parade.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The music and lighting effects
intertwined to
create incredible
immersion. And the
choreography took
advantage of the material
used in the
dancers' outfits.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: But above all...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The Carrot Queen was so... cute!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! But her cuteness doesn't just stop
at her
looks!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Her handwriting is just so adorable! I still have the autograph I got back as a student on display.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In fact, she's the very reason I
wanted to see
the parade today—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I just let the cat out of the bag, didn't
I? ...Ugh,
I really wanted to keep it a
secret!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
W-well, isn't it embarrassing to see?!
The way I
freak out and fangirl over her!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... What have I done?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, do me a favor, won't you?
Please keep
this a secret between the
two of us.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If anyone else was to find out about this,
I...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: 恥ずかしくないですよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that what drives her are the
strong
emotions she felt when she saw
the parade.
choice_data_list: 夢中になれるのは、いいことです

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You could be right about that. My
strong feelings
of adoration may have
been the beginning, in a
sense.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... There's no reason for me to
be
embarrassed. I should be enjoying
myself instead!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you stick with me for a little
longer,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to properly introduce you to the
things I
love!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Eek! How cute! This Carrot Queen ear
headband
looks perfect on you!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We have to buy it! Next up is the
long-awaited
meet and greet!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that means we need to buy an
autograph
board for her to sign! And it
wouldn't hurt to grab
a plushie, too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello radiates with joy as she fully
enjoys
everything about her beloved
Carrot Queen.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew... I really appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I should pay you back somehow for
your
kindness. Where would you like to
go?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Have any of the attractions caught your
eye?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first thing that comes to mind is the

refurbished ride that everyone's been
talking
about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The roller coaster?!
choice_data_list: ジェットコースターとか？

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-yeah, the roller coaster! S-s-sounds
like great
fun! C-c-count me in!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh? So you're not good with roller
coasters
eith—
choice_data_list: ――は、苦手なのでやめましょう！

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I mean, no problem! Let's scrap that
idea!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't tell a soul about
your fear of
roller coasters.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now we've both got a secret to
keep!
